_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O mmoledi {player_id} mo Tic Tac Toe ya Bamoledi ba Bararo.
Letshwao la gago ke '{symbol}'.
O tshameka ka go bea letshwao la gago mo bodulong bjo bo 5x5 go bopa mstari wa dinne.
Mistari e ka ba wa kgoro, wa thoko goba wa diagonal.
Romela tsamaiso ya gago ka go dirisa mokgwa wa '[4]' go lekola sekgoba sa 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopego sa go sepela se sego molaong. Diriša "[cell]" mo sele e lego 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomoro ya sele e sa šomego: {cell}. E swanetše go ba magareng ga 0 le {max_cell} .
invalid_move.already_occupied: Sele {cell} e šetše e na le motho.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Sebapadi {player_id} se dirile mosepelo wo o sa dumelelwago

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o hloma semelo sa gagwe ({symbol}) mo sephiring ({row}, {col}).
